raw_definitions: Definisi : n 1. network of fine filaments made by a spider, sarang labah-labah: the fly became entangled in the ~, lalat itu terperangkap dlm sarang labah-labah; 2. network, lingkaran: the ~ of social life, lingkaran kehidupan sosial; 3. flap of skin, selaput: the ~ between the toes of a frog, selaput di antara jari kaki katak. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
